assumptions: Screening results, jurisdiction, professional status and executed-agreement status arrive as attested facts signed by the borrower's compliance function; this repository does not perform the screening itself.

The re-screening interval of 30 days is read from clause 3.1 of the sample agreement. Attestations are issued with a matching validity window, so a lapse makes every fact unknown and denies the deposit.
Allocated lender capacity is set by the borrower outside the agreement and supplied as an attested fact.
The minimum commitment period and withdrawal cycle come from the market's terms, not the agreement text, and are supplied as attested facts.
This provider grants or withholds Wildcat deposit credentials. It does not move funds, set rates, or alter any market parameter.
